description: This source file defines the TextGetter class, which iterates and extracts text elements from a PDF content stream for inspection, including calculating positions and encoding text with font considerations.

classes.name: TextGetter
classes.description: A class that iterates through a PDF content stream to find and analyze text elements, calculating their positions and encoding details.

classes.name: TextGetter.TextInfo
classes.description: A nested class that holds information about a specific text element, including position, text content, encoding, and related state objects.

methods.name: IdentifyingElementCheck
methods.description: Checks if a content stream element is the 'Tj' operator, identifying text showing elements.

methods.name: GetObject
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs a TextInfo object for the current text element in the content stream.

methods.name: GetCurrentCoordinates
methods.description: Calculates the absolute position of a text element by summing offsets from preceding 'Td' operators.

methods.name: GetCurrentOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the x and y offsets from the content stream for positioning.

methods.name: MoveToPreviousTdInTextObject
methods.description: Moves the enumerator to the previous 'Td' operator within the same text object, stopping at 'BT' or beginning.
